journal_lines: §lWither skeleton§l in the corridor. Black bones. Gave it no room to swing.
§cBlade grazed my shoulder. §oFur went grey at the edges for an hour.§o Still cleared it.
Smelled like cold ash and old iron. Put it down.
Sword was longer than expected. Stayed low, came in under.
§oStood in a doorway, backlit by fire.§o Didn't wait for it to step through.
§cTook the withering for a moment. §oLegs felt heavy.§o Pushed through. Finished it.
Tall and quiet and armed. Backed it into a corner. Cleared it.
§lWither skeleton§l holding still in the dark. §oCoal smell.§o Smelled it before I saw it.
Two swings wide. Third one connected. Done.
Felled it. Skull and bones scattered across the floor. Took what mattered.
§oDeep place for a thing like this.§o Deeper than I like. Came home anyway.
§cBit of the blade. §oLeft a dark mark.§o Cleared it. Moved fast after.
